Name: No Island Trader Required
Author: cosplaywrite
Description:
Sick of barter culture taking over everywhere? Would you rather just part with some of your cold, hard cash? Look no further!

With No Island Trader Required, you can now purchase almost everything the bird trades with you for at shops on the mainland.

Click the spoilers below to learn what to buy and where:

[spoiler]All furniture and art is available for purchase at Robin's shop as you upgrade your farmhouse.[/spoiler]

[spoiler]Keep an eye out on the Saloon's menu come summer for a recipe for delicious banana pudding.[/spoiler]

[spoiler]Pierre might have a black market connection that hooked him up with banana and mango saplings, taro tuber and pineapple seeds, and deluxe retaining soil. (No one has been able to prove this illicit network.)[/spoiler]

[spoiler]And be sure to visit the Hat Mouse in Cindersap Forest for some new stylish headwear.[/spoiler]

Manifest.Name: No Island Trader Required
Manifest.Description: Adds some of the items from the Island Trader to the stock list of other shops and allows them to be purchased with money.
Manifest.Author: cosplaywrite
